name: @caotang/import-ao3
description: The AO3 adapter for the AO3 import (#297): reads the preface of an Archive of Our Own work download (HTML or EPUB) — rating, warnings, fandoms, relationships, characters and additional tags as keywords, characters as offered codex rows, the summary as the synopsis, and the work, chapter and end notes as notes — over the shared HTML walker and EPUB reader. No DOM, no third-party dependency; runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
